title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Florida State University
description: Ten under-21-safe Tallahassee food stops with directly documented midnight-or-later availability, spanning the campus edge and practical driving routes.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Tennessee Street Counter
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour dine-in and drive-through west of campus
cards.notes: Use the dining room for an indoor overnight stop, and confirm holiday hours on the location page before making the Tennessee Street run.
cards.short_summary: An all-night restaurant option on FSU’s western approach.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official location page lists both dine-in and drive-through service as open 24 hours every day at 1701 W Tennessee Street.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 1701 W TENNESSEE ST TALLAHASSEE, FL | Burgers, Fast Food, Shakes
cards.access_notes: Official hours show 24-hour dine-in and drive-through service Monday through Sunday; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The 5:30 A.M. Drive-Through Window
cards.subtitle: Very-late service on the commercial strip beside FSU
cards.notes: Check the service-mode schedule before leaving: the drive-through runs later than the dining room, so plan pickup accordingly.
cards.short_summary: A near-campus drive-through with unusually deep overnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-through hours until 5:30 a.m. daily at 1506 W Tennessee Street and identifies the location as open late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Tallahassee, FL - 1506 W Tennessee St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are listed as 8:00 a.m.–5:30 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours are shorter and should be checked separately.

cards.title: Cookies After the Dining Halls Wind Down
cards.subtitle: A bakery stop directly on West Tennessee Street
cards.notes: Choose pickup or delivery and verify the live ordering window first; the documented late service extends to 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-focused late run immediately beside the university area.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Tallahassee’s destination page identifies Insomnia Cookies at 1525 W Tennessee Street and states that it delivers fresh cookies until 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The destination page documents cookie delivery until 3:00 a.m.; verify the current pickup or delivery window before ordering.

cards.title: The West Tennessee Waffle House
cards.subtitle: A recognizable diner destination west of the main campus
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to confirm the address and call ahead if severe weather or a holiday could affect overnight access.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed diner anchoring the westbound late-night route.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official location site lists Waffle House #1192 at 1939 W Tennessee Street in Tallahassee.
cards.source_title: Southern breakfast food in Tallahassee, 32309 | Waffle House - Waffle House #1418
cards.access_notes: Waffle House identifies the 1939 W Tennessee Street restaurant on its official locator; confirm live overnight availability before departure.

cards.entity_name: Gaines Street Pies — 603 W Gaines Street
cards.title: Pizza on the Gaines Street Side
cards.subtitle: A local late kitchen southeast of FSU’s central campus
cards.notes: Aim for the Gaines Street storefront and check the posted schedule; Friday and Saturday service extends later than weeknights.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza counter connecting campus with the Gaines Street district.
cards.evidence_claim: Gaines Street Pies’ official locations page lists 603 W Gaines Street and hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: The Pensacola Street Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A west-side option with later weekend closing
cards.notes: Use this stop when heading west from campus; verify the day because Friday and Saturday extend one hour later than the weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward late drive-through on the West Pensacola corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-through service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 3030 West Pensacola Street: fast food, burgers, chicken, chicken sandwiches, salads, Frosty®, breakfast, open late, drive thru, meal deals in Tallahassee, FL
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours end at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A North Monroe All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour sit-down dining north of campus
cards.notes: Head here when an indoor table matters more than proximity; the official page lists walk-ins and round-the-clock restaurant service.
cards.short_summary: A full-service diner for overnight meals beyond the campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page lists the 2690 N Monroe Street restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins welcome.
cards.source_title: Denny's | 2690 N Monroe St | Order Online
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Wednesday through Tuesday; contact the restaurant about holiday changes.

cards.title: Pancakes on the Northbound Route
cards.subtitle: A documented 24-hour dining room on North Monroe Street
cards.notes: Pair this with a northbound trip from campus and confirm the location status online before leaving, especially around holidays.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours breakfast stop along Tallahassee’s main north corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official Tallahassee locator identifies the 2225 N Monroe Street restaurant as open 24 hours and offering late-night food and dine-in service.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Restaurant Locations in TALLAHASSEE, FL | Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner - Pancakes and more
cards.access_notes: IHOP’s locator marks this location “Open 24 Hours” and lists dine-in, takeout, delivery, and late-night food.

cards.title: The Lake Bradford Overnight Stop
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour service south of Doak Campbell Stadium
cards.notes: Use the dining room or drive-through for an overnight run; curbside ends at 10 p.m., so choose the correct service mode after that.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open restaurant on the Lake Bradford route.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger’s official page lists 24-hour dine-in, drive-through, and delivery every day at 815 Lake Bradford Road.
cards.source_title: Whataburger at 815 LAKE BRADFORD RD TALLAHASSEE, FL | Burgers, Fast Food, Shakes
cards.access_notes: Dine-in, drive-through, and delivery are listed as 24 hours daily; curbside is listed only from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: The Far-West Weekend Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Late service toward Tallahassee’s western edge
cards.notes: Save this for a vehicle-based westbound run; lobby hours finish earlier, while Friday and Saturday drive-through service is continuous.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through option for trips extending beyond the immediate campus strip.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page lists drive-through service until 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, with 24-hour service Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Tallahassee, FL at 5052 W Tennessee St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service ends at 1:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday and operates 24 hours Friday–Saturday; the lobby closes earlier.
